title: Right Timing
paragraphs: “What should we do today? The restoration is going smoothly, so maybe we should go hunting for materials.”
“Yeah. The Waves are a concern… and the mess with Faubrey should be settled soon, right?”
We chatted like that while walking toward the village square. Hmm… I looked at Itsuki and thought.
“Ah, it’s about time, isn’t it?”

If I base it on the previous and the time before that, the timing should be just right. Besides, I’ve subtly asked around to confirm, so there shouldn’t be any problems. During the Three Hero Church’s movement to overthrow the Queen, they didn’t make any big moves and just fattened their wallets. Rather, it seems they just provided support to protect their own positions.
“What is?”
“Itsuki, for a while, I want you to patrol the towns around Melromarc.”
I took out a map and pointed to the areas for Itsuki to cover. This was something Itsuki had asked me to do last time.
“Just act as you see fit there. No need to think too deeply, and don’t hesitate.”
“That’s a pretty vague instruction. Is there a reason for this?”
“What’s this about all of a sudden? Is something going on?”
Father and Itsuki both looked at me and asked.
“I was sworn to secrecy by the previous Itsuki, so I can’t say anything until it’s over.”
“…Sigh. And what happens if I don’t do it?”
“The last time, an enraged Itsuki shot me three times—in the forehead, stomach, and crotch—and was about to finish me off. That’s how mad he was.”
“What kind of explanation is that? Anyway, with that kind of story, wouldn’t it be better for Itsuki to just go along with it?”
“Even without an explanation, you’re telling me to just go? I guess… if it’s to avoid future regrets, I’ll do it.”
With that, Itsuki waved at Kou, who was playing with big sister and the others.
“I’m surprised you’re willing to go with just that explanation.”
“There’s probably something going on, just like when I helped Naofumi-san. I’ll do it. But don’t complain no matter how it turns out.”
“Of course. If my guess is wrong, I’ll explain everything in detail.”
Kou, hearing his name, came trotting over.
“What’s up, Kawasumi?”
“I’ll be heading out for a while. Do you want to come with me, Kou, or do you want to stay and play with Raphtalia-san and Rifana-san?”
“Hmm… I’ll go with Kawasumi.”
“Alright then, let’s go.”
Itsuki got on Kou’s back after he transformed into his Filolial form. Just like last time, it seems Kou will be helping Itsuki.
“Well then, we’re off.”
“Raphtalia, Rifana! Give me pats when I get back!”
“Okay.”
“Take care!”
Kou happily ran off with Itsuki on his back.
“Somehow…”
“Naofumi-chaaan, Raphtalia-chan, and Rifana-chan!”

From the sea, big sister’s sister came over. It seems that it’s time for Father and the others to do some leveling. And just like that, the day passed without any issues. A few days later, Itsuki returned after rescuing Stalker Pig.
“Bubwe?”
“Yes, this is the village where we’re working on the restoration, Rishia-san.”
“Bubububu, bubububu!”
Stalker Pig let out what seemed to be an introduction-like squeal in front of the slaves gathered to welcome Itsuki back.
“She was in trouble, so I used my authority to help her. This is fine, right?”
“So, something did happen after all?”
“Yes. There was still a typical corrupt noble lingering in Melromarc, and I ended up helping her.”

With that, Itsuki explained to Father and Ren the circumstances of Stalker Pig’s rescue. Because of the debt of gratitude for being saved, Stalker Pig expressed a strong desire to become Itsuki’s companion, which is why she was brought to the village.
“Rishia-san, we are fighting for the sake of the world, but we’re also helping with the village’s restoration.”
“Bubububu?”
“So, Motoyasu-san, can you tell me?”
“Mission complete!” I said loudly, as if to praise him, and Father, along with Itsuki and the others, looked at me with half-lidded eyes.
Getting that much attention makes me feel a little embarrassed.
“Shall I explain in detail? I believe the previous Itsuki said to only talk about this with the Heroes.”
“Is that so?”
“Well, for now, let’s just talk among the Heroes.”

And so, we went into the house to discuss. Stalker Pig was being looked after by big sister’s friend and Sakura-chan, who were explaining the situation in the village. As per what the previous Itsuki had told me, I talked about everything—whether to explain it all before sending him or to let him go without knowing.
“Well… it would definitely feel a bit disingenuous to go knowing everything.”
“If the result is good, then maybe it’s fine, but how does that balance against Itsuki’s guilt?”
“That’s true. It feels like I was dancing in the palm of someone’s hand, but I don’t think helping Rishia-san was a bad thing.”
“So? If I recall, the Itsuki from the first world thoroughly trapped her and abandoned her, right?”
“How twisted was I in that first world?”
“Even after being abandoned, she devoted herself to getting stronger and ended up taking care of Itsuki when he became a cripple due to the curse…”
“They say she transforms after reaching a certain level. Plus, she has plenty of potential for an energy boost.”
“A late bloomer, huh? She seems like someone who can be trusted, so wouldn’t it be fine to have her do her best?”
Father looked out the window at Stalker Pig talking with big sister and the others.
“So, she’s Itsuki’s destined partner…”
Ren looked at Itsuki with a somewhat envious expression.
“What’s the matter? I mean, I do think she’s cute, but…”
“No, Naofumi has Raphtalia and Sadeena, Motoyasu has Filo… a Filolial, and Itsuki has that Rishia girl. So what about me?”
Ah, so Ren is feeling left out after all? The previous Ren didn’t seem too bothered by it, though.
“Motoyasu. In all the previous loops, wasn’t there anyone who was my companion?”
“Ren, you have Kuro-chan and Keel-kun, don’t you? I know you get along really well with them.”
“Ugh… that’s not what I mean! Besides, Kuro is male, and Keel… well, that’s out of the question.”
“That’s a rather sad story. Well, Keel doesn’t seem like the type to get involved romantically, and Kuro looks like a boy dressed as a girl.”
“Itsuki, could you stay quiet for a bit? Your ability works through words as well.”
Ah, this is something Father often warns about. Itsuki’s accuracy ability works through his words, piercing right through people.
“Ren’s partner, huh? I’d say it’s probably Éclair or Assistant.”
In the first world, they were the ones who were often with him. The serious version of Ren was frequently with them. It was similar in the previous loop, though they seemed a bit more distant.
“Éclair… you mean Eclair-san? Wait, Ren’s close companion is Eclair-san?”
“She seemed like a very serious person. I can’t imagine her being with Ren…”
“You mean that female knight-like person?”
“Yes. Apparently, she was the one who stopped Ren when he went berserk due to the curse.”
“Hmm… I guess that’s possible. But that connection, huh…”
“By the way, they weren’t that close in the previous loop.”
“Maybe this is one of those things where we shouldn’t rely too much on the first world. So, what about Assistant?”
“Ren is her parents’ killer.”
At my words, Father and Itsuki both turned to look at Ren.
“Killing someone’s parents… that’s quite a cruel thing to do.”
“N-no! I’m not some heartless person!”
“And you caused an epidemic that led to the deaths of many in the eastern village.”
Itsuki glared at Ren with half-lidded eyes.
“That’s not true! I didn’t do any of that! Please believe me! Motoyasu, explain it properly!”
“Well, even if I say that… I remember getting scolded for talking about this last time.”
“What the hell did you say?!”
Oh? Is it okay to talk about it now? Well, I mentioned it last time too, so it should be fine.
